name: @openagt/store-filesystem
description: OpenAgent's store on this computer, the end of the store's chain: each scope's files in its folder, the person's own folder among them. Beside it, the files OpenAgent writes outside the chain: the personal folder's writes, a project's data there or on its repository's agent-data branch (checked out under .branches/, every write one sync-commit-push cycle), a module's command's reads and writes of it, and why a project's data stays on this computer.
